import ipaddress, json, random, subprocess, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import native, fib, layout, planner
bin=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else '/workspace/tmp/engine2'
rng=random.Random(4)

def runin(text):
    t=time.time()
    p=subprocess.run([bin],input=text.encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    assert p.returncode==0, p.stderr.decode()[:200]
    return p.stdout.decode(), time.time()-t

# ATLAS 30000 routes
routes={}
for _ in range(30000):
    length=rng.randint(0,128); v=rng.getrandbits(128); size=1<<(128-length)
    routes[(v//size*size,length)]=rng.randint(0,2147483647)
lines=["ATLAS 30000"]+["%032x %d %d"%(s,l,h) for (s,l),h in rng_sample ] if False else None
items=list(routes.items()); rng.shuffle(items)
lines=["ATLAS %d"%len(items)]+["%032x %d %d"%(s,l,h) for (s,l),h in items]
out,dt=runin("\n".join(lines)+"\n")
toks=out.split()
R=int(toks[0])
starts=[int(toks[i],16) for i in range(1,2*R,2)]
hops=[None if toks[i+1]=="-1" else int(toks[i+1]) for i in range(1,2*R,2)]
py=fib.runs_of(dict(items))
print("ATLAS 30000: R=%d %.2fs match=%s"%(R,dt,(starts,hops)==[list(x) for x in py]))

# PACK max: R=64, N large, A=8192
starts64,hops64=py if len(py[0])<=64 else (py[0][:64],py[1][:64])
R=min(64,len(py[0])); st=py[0][:R]; hp=py[1][:R]
nodes=planner.to_bfs([{"lo":0,"span":R,"mode":0,"cached":1,"children":[]}]) if R<=8 else None
if nodes is None:
    # build a 9-ary tree
    nodes=[]
    def add(i,j):
        n={"lo":i,"span":j-i,"mode":0,"cached":(j-i)%2,"children":[]}
        idx=len(nodes); nodes.append(n)
        if j-i>8:
            b=min(9,j-i); size=(j-i)//b; bounds=[]
            cur=i
            for k in range(b):
                end=(cur+size if k<b-1 else j); bounds.append((cur,end)); cur=end
            n["children"]=[add(a,bb) for a,bb in bounds]
        return idx
    add(0,R)
    nodes=planner.to_bfs(nodes)
# assign legal modes
for n in nodes:
    spread=st[n["lo"]+n["span"]-1]-st[n["lo"]]
    n["mode"]= 2 if spread<1<<32 else (1 if spread<1<<64 else 0)
addrs=[rng.getrandbits(128) for _ in range(8192)]
lines=["PACK %d %d %d"%(R,len(nodes),len(addrs))]+["%032x %s"%(s,-1 if h is None else h) for s,h in zip(st,hp)]
for n in nodes:
    lines.append(" ".join(map(str,[n["lo"],n["span"],n["mode"],n["cached"],len(n["children"])]+n["children"])))
lines+=["%032x"%a for a in addrs]
out,dt=runin("\n".join(lines)+"\n")
toks=out.split()
image=toks[0]
print("PACK R=%d N=%d A=8192: %.2fs match_python=%s"%(R,len(nodes),dt,image==layout.build(st,hp,nodes).hex()))
# parse answers
ans=[]; at=1
for _ in addrs:
    hop,rank,count=int(toks[at]),int(toks[at+1]),int(toks[at+2]); at+=3+count
    ans.append((None if hop==-1 else hop,rank,[int(x) for x in toks[at-count:at]]))
size,parsed,order,decoded=layout.decode(bytes.fromhex(image))
exp=[layout.search(parsed,decoded,a) for a in addrs]
print(" answers match:", [list(e) for e in exp]==[list(a) for a in ans])
# TRACE same image
lines=["TRACE %d"%len(addrs),image]+["%032x"%a for a in addrs]
out,dt=runin("\n".join(lines)+"\n")
toks=out.split(); ans2=[]; at=0
for _ in addrs:
    hop,rank,count=int(toks[at]),int(toks[at+1]),int(toks[at+2]); at+=3+count
    ans2.append((None if hop==-1 else hop,rank,[int(x) for x in toks[at-count:at]]))
print(" TRACE: %.2fs match=%s"%(dt,ans2==[list(e) for e in ans]))
# A=0 pack
